prompt: "Reimagine the timeless elegance of Goryeo Celadon by integrating its intricate patterns and serene balance with the dynamic vibrancy of modern digital aesthetics. Traditional motifs such as lotus flowers, cranes, and waves emerge as flowing holographic light patterns, radiating soft neon hues. These patterns shift and transform in an ethereal dance of symmetry and fluidity, capturing the essence of both static beauty and dynamic evolution. The celadon itself appears as a translucent, glowing artifact, dissolving and reforming through luminous streams, symbolizing the harmonious fusion of past traditions and contemporary innovation. The background blends abstract ink-wash textures with diffused, ambient light, creating a meditative yet futuristic atmosphere. --ar 9:16 --stylize 250 --v 6.1
